_doc: CENTRAL REGISTRY of known hit categories — the source of truth for sorting/bucketing gem5 hits and viewing them in the dashboard. As we triage hits (writing a diag_*.py + bug .md in a run's diagnostics/), we REGISTER the category here. Each category links to the testsets/builds it SCOPES to (per CLAUDE.md propagation rules: a model/concretization artifact scopes to its testset only; a build behavior scopes to all runs on that build). The per-run diagnostics/buckets/summary.json gives the COUNTS; the dashboard joins those to this registry for labels, verdicts, and colors. Anything not matching a category stays NEW_candidate_pure_bug = the research signal.

checker.label: checker false positive
checker.note: the checker over-counted; not a real gem5 leak

artifact.label: model/concretization artifact
artifact.note: Alloy over-approximation or codegen artifact; not a real leak

new.label: NEW — unexplained
new.note: cleared all disqualifiers, not yet explained — THE research signal

phases.disqualifier: run first; if matched, the hit is NOT a real leak

check_ld_no_completion.label: check_ld no-completion (over-count)
check_ld_no_completion.description: check_ld flagged an in-window load that never actually completed/obtained data → not a leak.

recon_slf.label: Recon STL/SLF store-forward bypass
recon_slf.description: Store-to-load forwarding bypasses Recon's taint check — a real recon bug (double-gated signature).

constaddr_load.label: constant-address load
constaddr_load.description: Load address is a constant operand (zero-index) → data-taint over-approximation; not an STT/SpecLFB disqualifier.

nonspec_cotransmit.label: SPT non-spec co-transmit (pre-fix model artifact)
nonspec_cotransmit.description: SPT model-generation artifact (fixed by the inaddr-cleanup regen); disqualifier, not a real leak.

rf_clobber.label: rf-clobber (stale reaching-def)
rf_clobber.description: A later writer clobbers the rf source between producer and use → not a genuine speculative dependency.

branch_wrongpath_respec.label: branch wrong-path re-speculation (RAS artifact)
branch_wrongpath_respec.description: gadget retq/loop re-speculation (gem5-spt delays tainted branches to VP) — control-flow/RAS artifact.

vp_squash_race.label: STT/SPT VP↔squash race
vp_squash_race.description: Untaint on resolved-not-committed vs the squash — the one known STT/SPT speculative-window race.

NEW_candidate_pure_bug.label: NEW — unexplained (research signal)
NEW_candidate_pure_bug.description: Hits that cleared ALL disqualifiers and match no known real-bug signature. The set to root-cause.
